rule: Every valid reserved row of every directed link and radio setting, the IDLab training half.
procedure: fit_profiles.fit_ade_model: maximum likelihood of the asymmetric Laplace density with scales slope times measured range plus intercept, over individual reports, Nelder-Mead from (0.02, 20, 0.01, 40) with nonnegative slopes and positive intercepts. Residual is the converted range minus the planar distance.

conversion.rule: max(0, gain * range + offset), the affine correction fitted on the reserved rows

previous.source: idlab-training.json profiles.ade_ranging_model, the same reserved rows against the surveyed 3D distance

source_note: The source of the frozen campaigns is confirmed. They fitted the same reserved rows with the same correction, against the surveyed distance in three dimensions. The refit takes the planar distance of the baseline's procedure. The node heights differ by less than ten centimetres.
